record.title: HEARTWATCH: remote cardiac monitoring
record.programme: Science Fund of the Republic of Serbia (synthetic)
record.summary: HEARTWATCH is a three-year research project funded by the Science Fund of the Republic of Serbia, running from 2022 to 2025, with Associate Professor Maja Popović serving as principal investigator. The project addresses the clinical need for reliable, long-term remote cardiac monitoring outside hospital settings, targeting particularly the early detection of atrial fibrillation in high-risk populations. The core technical objective is the development of a complete algorithmic stack—spanning signal quality assessment, motion-artifact suppression, real-time arrhythmia classification, and adaptive false-alarm reduction—capable of executing on a low-power wearable ECG patch. A secondary objective is the creation of a clinically annotated benchmark dataset in partnership with the Clinical Centre of Vojvodina. By project completion, HEARTWATCH aims to deliver open-source firmware validated in a prospective pilot study involving at least 120 participants, providing a translational foundation for commercialization through collaboration with medical device companies.
